positions.statement: In a July 2026 letter to Oregon's data center advisory committee, Sens. Wyden and Merkley asked it to consider several issues raised by Oregonians, including electricity costs for consumers.
positions.excerpt: Increasing electricity costs for consumers because of increased demand.
